# fapi2-profile

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/fapi2-profile.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `fapi2-profile` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.fapi2`: generated from its catalogue, [fapi2-profile.json](../../servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/fapi2-profile.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_FAPI2_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FAPI` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS` (init-param `clients`, then system property `oidf.fapi2.clients`, then env `OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS`) | Unset; a list | The FAPI clients, space- or comma-separated; * is every client. The FAPI 2.0 filter holds them to issuer-only assertion audiences and PS256, ES256 or EdDSA DPoP proofs, and at UserInfo the resource-server filter sets x-fapi-interaction-id for them and refuses their access tokens in the query | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): FAPI does not start. An id that names no client holds nobody | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FAPI_RESOURCE_CLIENTS` (init-param `resourceClients`, then system property `oidf.fapi.resource.clients`, then env `OIDF_FAPI_RESOURCE_CLIENTS`) | Unset; a list | More clients the resource-server filter holds to the FAPI rules at UserInfo (x-fapi-interaction-id set, access tokens in the query refused), space- or comma-separated; * is every client. For FAPI 1.0 clients, such as FAPI-CIBA's, whose token requests are not the FAPI 2.0 filter's to judge; the clients OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS lists are held to the rules without being named here | **Per request**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the rules apply to every client at UserInfo, and a warning says so. An id that names no client holds nobody | Any | Yes |
